comment: NPC region piece and era trim slots (cosmos_chimera docs/design/npc-uma-looks.md#服裝, row 17), built by npc_outfit.py on both bases of every race below: what NpcMeshes Signature (piece_<ArchRegion>) and the era block of Dress (trim_<ArchEra>) draw, refitted to the base's body. Agrarian and Mercantile have no trim (their era shows in the cut and sleeves, Q-A26). The cut slots are not built until Q-A26 is decided.
races_comment: Every race the game assembles on UMA (NpcMeshes.UmaCarries): skeletons, automata and crabfolk stay procedural and, the first two, unclothed.
